notes.title: New hand gestures and more...
notes.content:
63 days have gone since the last release of Zephyrus Prelude... and here VR 🙂 again fresh, crispy features new content elements and more fun... thanks to our talented developer team. 
We have all put in a lot of blood, sweat, and tears but the result is definitely high class. 
We are pleased to announce the latest improvements!
For more insider tip click to our Dev Diary on [url=https://discord.com/channels/850268885524676648/918099298984538112]DISCORD[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592021/a2c635986beda3526087688008f60f01b9cb6601.png[/img]
[b]Whats new?[/b]

[list]
[*] Support Valve Index headset
[*] New hand gestures and hand collision with the environment
[*] Volumetric environment audios on Quest 2 and Pc build
[*] Tunok voices in the tutorial
[/list] 


[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The inGame menu was not working during the dwarf curse
[*] Performance issues on Quest platform in case of multiplayer sessions
[/list]

[b]Known issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] Q1 shadow does not follow the player's head properly
[/list]

[b]What comes next?[/b]
[list]
[*] Add survive the waves mode
[*] Add new battle magic
[*] Add new enemies
[*] Expanding mana usage
[*] Add new game mechanics
[*] Add new map 
[/list]

notes.title: Zephyrus Prelude 3.0
notes.content:
In this update, we introduce [b]The bridge of Truth[/b]. This is a whole new map that completes the story of [b]The Dark River Ruins[/b] and the [b]Abandoned Shires[/b]. The new map is with an entirely new biome.
[previewyoutube=Q0zImK_2tWs;full][/previewyoutube]
Besides that, the following new features are also added:
[list]
[*] New traps
[*] New enemies
[*] New battle magic
[*] New side quest for every map
[/list]

The following Bugs are fixed:
[list]
[*] Incorrect spatial sounds fixed
[*] Tons of performance issues fixed
[*] If a button is being pressed continuously during scene changing then always the SetupRoom scene appeared
[/list]

Known issues:
[list]
[*] Strange noise at start room on Level 3
[*] The inGame menu is not working during the dwarf curse
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2.4
notes.content:
[h2]New features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Teleport movement mechanics
     [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592021/84a3479dbe9fb905667bbab26ac6422b5e06df41.gif[/img]
[*] New environment physics
[*] New navigation system
[*] New impact sound system
[*] Visual+gameplay hint for maps at map selection
[*] In-Game Menu (hood, music on/off)
     [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592021/c2b1e629973e9de646366b9abad9af7621227319.gif[/img]
[*] Effects on Avatars in Magical Areas
[/list]

[h3]The Dark River Ruins[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new effects in Magic areas
[*] Added new effects in Labyrinth
[*] Sound overhaul
[*] Collision overhaul
[*] Added Navigation mechanics
[/list]

[h3]Abandoned Shrine[/h3]
[list]
[*] New singleplayer/multiplayer challenges
[*] Added new effects in Magic areas
[*] Collision overhaul
[*] Added Navigation mechanics
[*] Added new game mechanics
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tutorial updated
[*] Text drawing quality improvement
[*] Better shader for real-time lighting
[*] More "Curse" events
[*] New shading and lighting in the Waiting Room. The lighting globe has a new shader.
[*] New visual for player teleportation
[*] Lobby optimization
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lag in Avatar movement in multiplayer
[*] Lag in Crystal light movement in multiplayer
[*] Puzzle pieces sometimes could not be moved by magic focus
[*] Sometimes the magic marker on your hand didn't glow in the dark when you acquired a particular school of magic.
[/list]

[h3]Known issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] Portal cube is not rendered in the mirror
[*] InGame menu is not working during the dwarf curse
[*] The portal cube can be thrown through menu buttons
[*] Some sounds are played incorrectly or cut off
[*] On some corners, you can teleport too close to walls where you can get your head in the wall and the visual penalty kicks in. In this case, use your stick to move out or check that you have left your Hero's Circle, which you can see at your feet.
[/list]

[h2]Future[/h2]
In the meantime, the team is working on new maps, upgrading existing maps, new game modes such as combat, platform mechanics, new spells, creatures and continues to polish the current state of the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592021/3523c8070288be6504e0a4764be55f0d23fe5153.png[/img]
You can follow these in our dev-diary on the Discord channel, where we welcome further suggestions, feedback and answer questions.
We welcome anyone interested in the development of this game!
[url=https://discord.com/invite/Jj3r4gFH2x]Discord Zephyrus[/url]
